_doc: MVP starting rules. See design/DESIGN_RULES.md for why each value is what it is.

clock._doc: A day is day_seconds of real time and starts in the morning (Day N, 00 s is daylight, as in the reference screens). Phases are fractions of the day; the sky, light and anything that cares about night read them from here.

progression._doc: Player level and per-building mastery. EXP is given for completed, meaningful actions (a harvest, a building finished, land bought) -- never for taps. exp_to_next[N-1] is the EXP from level N to N+1; past the list the last step grows by `growth`.

land._doc: Price of the k-th purchased cell (k = 0 for the first): round_to * ceil(base * growth^k / round_to). Only cells sharing an edge with owned land can be bought.

economy._doc: How many days of money history to keep (status/analytics read it).

unlocks._doc: What the player must reach before something can be used. Buildings carry their own `unlock` in buildings.json; research (Step 22) adds its own.

momo._doc: Momo agents. Names are translation keys momo.name.N, handed out in order. Hiring price of the k-th hired Momo (k = 0 first) = round_to * ceil(base * growth^k / round_to). Unassigned Momo wander their island at walk_speed tiles/s, resting rest_seconds between strolls, and sleep at night. An assigned Momo does its building's work by itself, each stage taking work_time_multiplier times the player's time (cooldowns are world rules and stay as they are); with works_at_night true they keep at it under the moon, as in the reference night scene.

proficiency._doc: A Momo's skill at one kind of building grows with the stages it has finished there: reaching thresholds[i] stages gives level i+1, and its work there takes multipliers[level] of its usual Momo time (level 0 = 1.0). Skill is per building type and stays with the Momo.

watch._doc: Watched tiles: each Momo works the buildings on the tiles it watches, the nearest ready one first. A Momo assigned to a building (dragged, or by the manager) watches that building's tiles; the pencil edits the set. `base_tiles` is how many one Momo may watch before research (watch_tiles effects add).

mail._doc: Momo Letters (data/letters.json). At most letters_per_day new letters arrive on one in-game day.

offline._doc: Progress while the game is closed: the simulation runs the time away exactly as if open and untouched (assigned Momo, drip lines, waits, research, the daily sale). Time away counts up to max_hours; at most max_events events are handled (the clock stops at the last one) -- a deterministic cost ceiling, never an estimate. A summary shows when at least report_seconds passed and something happened. autosave_seconds: how often the game saves while open (also when the window loses focus).

power._doc: Power is capacity, not stored energy: supply now (kW) against the draw of the buildings working now. A stage takes its power share when it starts -- satisfaction = supply / (draw of everything running + its own), capped at 1 -- and keeps that speed to its end (no continuous physics). Solar follows the sun (zero at night, peak at midday, the sky's own phases); wind follows a smooth deterministic gust curve (wind_* below) day and night; steam is steady while stoked; hydro is steady but needs the shore.

manager._doc: A Momo at an office manages: every review_seconds it moves at most moves_per_review workers -- never one the player placed (pinned) -- from a building idle and blocked for stuck_seconds, or set to off, to the highest-priority building with a free spot and work it can do; and it sends free Momo only to high-priority spots. Moves are walks, never instant.

community._doc: Momo life. Each Momo gets a home in id order from the homes' capacity (oldest homes first); unhoused Momo rest outdoors (rest 1.0). Island happiness 0..max_happiness is the sum of open amenities, each type counting its i-th copy at stack[i] (none beyond the list). Work time at a building is multiplied by the Momo's rest times (1 - happiness / max_happiness * happiness_effect), never below floor.

analytics._doc: The island's daily book (AnalyticsSystem): written from events, plus a look at power and idle buildings every sample_seconds; keep_days closed days are kept.

construction._doc: Demolishing a finished building returns this share of everything paid for it (building and refits), rounded down per item; cancelling one still under construction returns its type's `refund` (all of it).

prestige._doc: Selling the settlement (PrestigeSystem). Appraisal: every building's paid money x value.buildings (by family), land bought x value.land, daily sale+release income (last 7 days) x value.income_days, each Momo value.momo_base + value.momo_per_skill per skill level, completed research money cost x value.research, all experience gained x value.exp. Net value = appraisal - the head start the island was given. Legacy points ever earned = floor(sqrt(lifetime net / points_unit)); a sale adds what it lifts that by. Selling needs player level min_level. Points give, permanently: rewards.money_per_point starting money each, a starting Momo every rewards.momo_every (at most max_momos), and Momo work time x (1 - work_per_point per point, at most work_cap).

research._doc: Research levels. A node can be researched again up to its max_level (5 unless its effects are switches -- auto, recipe, variety, power_use -- which stop at 1, or the node sets max_level). Level L costs money x level_cost_growth^(L-1) and items x level_item_growth^(L-1) -- never more of an item than the store can hold, so every level can be reached -- and takes seconds x level_time_growth^(L-1); its effects grow by level_strength per level past the first: a multiply m becomes m^(1 + level_strength x (L-1)), an add becomes add x (1 + level_strength x (L-1)). At Prestige every level researched in that run becomes one research point (RP) for good; RP are allocated to unlocked nodes as levels, freely re-allocated, never minted twice.

specials._doc: Special structures: how many may stand at once (`slots`, one village special until settlement tiers raise it).
